newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria imposes further energy price rises.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria imposes further energy price rises.

text.p: Bulgaria's Energy Ministry on Friday said power prices would be raised by an average 14 percent for October as part of a system revising energy prices each month.
The increases are in accordance with the inflation rate and the lev/dollar exchange rate.
Bulgaria imposed energy price increases averaging 118 percent for July and 22 percent for August.
Since mid-April the lev has tumbled from 78 to around 234 to the dollar, eroding the value of recent price rises.
Bulgaria imports more than 80 percent of raw materials for its energy sector and pays for the supplies after it exchanges levs for dollars.
The new prices of electricity, coal and heating will include value-added tax at 22 percent.
